title: RDJ says Doomsday is commentary on the world right now

author: CBR
description:
In anticipation of Avengers: Doomsday, we sat down with Robert Downey Jr. and Joe Russo to discuss Avengers: Infinity War, its impact and an oral history of the greatest moments from the MCU.

How do you muster the bravery to turn your hero into a villain and eventually kill him off? And how do you decide when to come back for more? We dig into the scale, the hype and the depth of this chapter in our favorite characters' stories.

On the 🎤: Sean O'Connell

0:00 The Biggest Challenge of Making Infinity War
2:36 Why the Avengers Are Always One Step Behind
3:39 Engineering Spider-Man’s Heartbreaking Death
4:52 Building Tony and Peter’s Relationship Backward
5:51 Why Infinity War Had to End in Disaster
8:01 The Guardians of the Galaxy Crossover Scene That Was Mostly Improvised
14:01 Why they had to kill Tony Stark
21:35 Pitching Tony Stark’s Multi-Movie Arc from Civil War to Endgame.
28:10 How Thanos Became Infinity War’s Main Character

---------------------------------------------------
